SELECT m.member_id memberId, m.login_id loginId, d.name, d.email, TO_CHAR(d.birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') birth, d.phone, d.address, d.profile FROM members m
LEFT JOIN member_details d ON m.member_id = d.member_id
WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) sns_count FROM social_accounts WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND provider_user_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE member_details d SET phone = #{phone}, address = #{address, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE d.member_id = #{memberId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM members m WHERE m.member_id = d.member_id AND m.status = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM social_accounts s WHERE s.member_id = d.member_id AND s.provider_user_id IS NOT NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT password pwd FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 0

SELECT w.workspace_id workId, wm.workspace_member_id AS workMemberId, w.subject, wm.role, wd.domain_key domainKey FROM workspace_members wm
JOIN workspaces w ON wm.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
JOIN workspace_domains wd ON w.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id
JOIN members m ON wm.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND wd.active = 'Y' AND m.status = 0 ORDER BY wm.role DESC, w.workspace_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT t.task_id FROM tasks t
JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id
JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pm.workspace_member_id = #{workMemberId} AND pm.status = 0 AND pm."LEFT" IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND t.status IN (1, 2) AND ( t.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_members tm WHERE tm.task_id = t.task_id AND tm.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id ) )
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT st.sub_task_id FROM sub_tasks st
JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = st.project_id
JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_id = p.project_id
WHERE pm.workspace_member_id = #{workMemberId} AND pm.status = 0 AND pm."LEFT" IS NULL AND p.deleted IS NULL AND st.deleted IS NULL AND st.status IN (1, 2) AND ( st.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_task_members stm WHERE stm.sub_task_id = st.sub_task_id AND stm.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id ) ) )

SELECT wm.workspace_member_id workMemberId, wm.workspace_id workId, wm.role FROM workspace_members wm
JOIN workspaces w ON w.workspace_id = wm.workspace_id
JOIN workspace_domains wd ON wd.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = wm.member_id
WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workId} AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.role != 70 AND w.member_id != #{memberId} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND m.status = 0 FOR UPDATE OF wm.status
SELECT chat_room_id FROM chat_rooms WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT wm.workspace_member_id FROM chat_room_members crm
JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = crm.workspace_member_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = wm.member_id
JOIN chat_rooms cr ON cr.chat_room_id = crm.chat_room_id
WHERE crm.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND cr.chat = 'GROUP' AND crm.workspace_member_id != #{workMemberId} AND crm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND wm.workspace_id = #{workId}
ORDER BY crm.joined ASC, crm.chat_room_member_id ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members crm
JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = crm.workspace_member_id
JOIN chat_rooms cr ON cr.chat_room_id = crm.chat_room_id
JOIN workspace_members owner ON owner.workspace_member_id = cr.workspace_member_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = wm.member_id
WHERE crm.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND owner.workspace_id = #{workId} AND crm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND m.status = 0

SELECT md.name FROM workspace_members wm
JOIN member_details md ON md.member_id = wm.member_id WHERE wm.workspace_member_id = #{workMemberId}
